enable_confidence_steer_slew_limit.description: when enabled, limit published steering rate when reference spatial extent ahead of ego is short (soft hold on curves during planner hesitation)

reference_confidence_L_ahead_min.description: spatial arc length [m] below which reference curvature is treated as low-confidence

reference_confidence_L_ahead_ref.description: spatial arc length [m] at or above which reference is fully trusted for steer slew limiting

reference_confidence_time_check.description: time horizon [s] for measuring spatial arc length ahead of ego on the reference trajectory

steer_slew_rate_min_rad_s.description: minimum steering rate limit [rad/s] applied when reference confidence is lowest (soft hold)

steer_slew_rate_nom_rad_s.description: nominal steering rate limit [rad/s] applied when reference confidence is highest
